questions.question: The process of selecting a desired frequency out of a complex wave is called

explanations.a: Amplification increases signal strength, not selectivity.
explanations.b: Incorrect; one of the options is valid.
explanations.d: Correct. Tuning allows selection of desired frequency. Learn more

questions.question: The Q-factor of the resistance coil is ..................

explanations.b: Correct. Coils typically have a high Q-factor.
explanations.d: Possible in poor quality coils but not typical.

questions.question: Higher the Q-factor of the resonant circuit, its bandwidth is

explanations.a: Too extreme; it's narrow but not zero.
explanations.b: Correct. Higher Q means narrower bandwidth. Learn more
explanations.c: Incorrect. Wider bandwidth means lower Q.

questions.question: What will happen if parallel RL connected to a DC power source?

answers.a: Minimum current will flow through circuit.
answers.c: No current will flow through circuit.
answers.d: Maximum current will flow through circuit.

explanations.d: Correct. Inductor becomes shorted after steady-state; max current through resistor.

questions.question: If 10Ω resistor and 10 Henry inductor connected parallel. What will be the total resistance between the components if it is connected with 5 V DC power supply?

explanations.b: Inductor becomes short after steady-state; not infinite.
explanations.c: Correct. After a long time, inductor acts as short; current flows through resistor only.
